name: GERDA
summary: GERDA searched for germanium-76 neutrinoless double-beta decay with enriched high-purity germanium detectors immersed in liquid argon. Its final dataset and background-control methods underpin the succeeding LEGEND programme.
detection_principle: Germanium crystals are both isotope source and calorimeter. Pulse-shape analysis and an instrumented liquid-argon scintillation veto reject backgrounds around the 2039 keV decay endpoint.

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: GERDA completed its search without observing a neutrinoless-decay signal.

results.summary: GERDA completed its search without observing a neutrinoless-decay signal.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
